---
title: "Rust API"
---

## Crates

| Crate | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `gridwell-ir` | IR types, parsing, validation |
| `gridwell-core` | Shared utilities (colors, units) |
| `gridwell-writer-html` | HTML renderer |
| `gridwell-writer-latex` | LaTeX renderer |
| `gridwell-writer-typst` | Typst renderer |
| `gridwell-writer-rtf` | RTF renderer |
| `gridwell-writer-svg` | SVG renderer |
| `gridwell-writer-ansi` | Terminal renderer |
| `gridwell-writer-pandoc` | Pandoc AST renderer |
| `gridwell-writer-quarto` | Quarto renderer |
| `gridwell-writer-docx` | Word renderer |
| `gridwell-writer-xlsx` | Excel renderer |
| `gridwell-writer-pptx` | PowerPoint renderer |

## Parsing

```rust
use gridwell_ir::Table;

let json = std::fs::read_to_string("table.json")?;
let table = Table::from_json(&json)?;
```

## Validation

```rust
let errors = table.validate();
if errors.is_empty() {
    println!("Table is valid");
} else {
    for err in &errors {
        eprintln!("Validation error: {err}");
    }
}
```

## Text Rendering

```rust
use gridwell_writer_html::{render_html, HtmlWriter, HtmlWriterConfig};

// Default settings
let html = render_html(&table)?;

// Custom config
let config = HtmlWriterConfig {
    inline_styles: true,
    pretty_print: false,
    class_prefix: "my-table".to_string(),
};
let writer = HtmlWriter::with_config(config);
let html = writer.render(&table)?;
```

### All Text Writers

```rust
gridwell_writer_html::render_html(&table)?;
gridwell_writer_latex::render_latex(&table)?;
gridwell_writer_typst::render_typst(&table)?;
gridwell_writer_rtf::render_rtf(&table)?;
gridwell_writer_svg::render_svg(&table)?;
gridwell_writer_ansi::render_ansi(&table)?;
gridwell_writer_pandoc::render_pandoc(&table)?;
gridwell_writer_quarto::render_quarto(&table)?;
```

## Binary Rendering

```rust
use gridwell_writer_docx::render_docx;
use gridwell_writer_xlsx::render_xlsx;
use gridwell_writer_pptx::render_pptx;

let docx_bytes = render_docx(&table)?;
std::fs::write("output.docx", &docx_bytes)?;
```

## Error Handling

```rust
use gridwell_ir::{Table, ParseError};

match Table::from_json(input) {
    Ok(table) => { /* use table */ },
    Err(ParseError::Json(e)) => eprintln!("Invalid JSON: {e}"),
}
```
